rows.label: tlk70000057_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Aunt Ranea has long, pretty hair,
and she smells really nice.

rows.label: tlk70000057_04_msg0002
rows.name:
She has flower oil that makes hair
shine, and nice-smelling water too.

rows.label: tlk70000057_04_msg0003
rows.name:
But Mom says I shouldn't copy things
like that, and won't tell me why.

rows.label: tlk70000057_04_msg0004
rows.name:
Grown-ups always tell you what
you can't do. I don't ever want
to become like that.
